How to wear a wool & silk camisole

A camisole is the most discreet base layer: thin straps disappear under shirts, knitwear and dresses, and the fine knit adds warmth without bulk. Choose pure silk for a light, smooth layer in spring and summer, or wool & silk for warmth from autumn to spring.

Want more coverage on the shoulders? Try a tank top or a short-sleeve top.
